title: A fair foundation warms you both

captions.energy: Sharing involvement with a fair measure
captions.emotions: Feeling the fullness of received warmth

meaning: Your agreements can create warmth when a fair measure of help takes both people’s needs into account.
text: A dependable agreement can have a very warm result. In the physical position of Anahata, the Emperor expresses care through definite actions: dividing a task, making time and fulfilling an accepted responsibility. Justice in energy brings a wish to consider demands fairly, relating each request to the capacities of you both. The Empress in emotions offers pleasure in received attention. It can feel more comfortable simply to have a request heard and no longer hold everything in mind. Tenderness is felt through room for rest created by an understandable action.

Suppose one person needs quiet time to finish something personal while shopping and cooking remain for the evening. You agree who takes which tasks and when the other person will have time afterwards. **A fair agreement can make room for pleasure.** Meeting at the table feels easier: help has happened, commitments were considered, and neither person must guess an unspoken expectation. Warmth does not require identical involvement at every minute in order to remain mutual.

The difficulty is organising care so thoroughly that its pleasure goes unnoticed. A completed action becomes a ticked box, gratitude seems unnecessary, and tenderness is expected to arrive automatically. Fair distribution then leaves both people without a living response. Support benefits from clear responsibilities and from noticing the person whose involvement made an ordinary evening more comfortable.
